title: Sloth holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x="10" y="72" width="80" height="7" rx="3" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <rect x="10" y="72" width="80" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#a86d38"/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#9a7b52"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#c4a878"/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="52" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#9a7b52" transform="rotate(-25 34 52)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="52" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#9a7b52" transform="rotate(25 66 52)"/>
  <!-- claws -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="2.5" fill="#e8d9b8"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="47" r="2.5" fill="#e8d9b8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="17" ry="14" fill="#b69768"/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#e8d9b8"/>
  <!-- eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="31" rx="4.5" ry="5" fill="#5a4630"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="31" rx="4.5" ry="5" fill="#5a4630"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="31" r="2" fill="#0d0d1a"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="31" r="2" fill="#0d0d1a"/>
  <circle cx="43.6" cy="30.4" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57.6" cy="30.4" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#4a3520"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M47 41 Q50 43.5 53 41" stroke="#4a3520" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="24" r="3" fill="#9a7b52"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="24" r="3" fill="#9a7b52"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 62 C42 54 34 56 34 62 C34 68 50 76 50 76 C50 76 66 68 66 62 C66 56 58 54 50 62 Z" fill="#e63950"/>
  <path d="M46 61 C42 58 39 59 39 62 C39 65 46 70 46 70" fill="#ff6b7d" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- hanging feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="76" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#9a7b52"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="76" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#9a7b52"/>
</svg>
